title: Topic 16
japanese_text:
A：<u>足取り</u>が重いけど大丈夫？
B：歩きすぎて足が棒になってる。<u>頂上</u>への<u>到達</u>は厳しいかも…。
A：登り始めたときは、頂上まで行くって意気込んでたじゃん。
B：もっと<u>身軽</u>にして来るべきだった…。ちょっと休んでもいい？少し休めば<u>復活</u>するかも。
english_translation: A: Your steps are very slow. Are you all right? B: My legs feel heavy from too much walking. I might have a tough time reaching the summit ... A: When we started climbing, you were so enthusiastic about making it to the top. B: I should have packed more lightly ... Can we take a break? Maybe a little rest will revive me.
